extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants, referees/reviewers, institutional grant administrators, and NIH program staff
extracted.subtask_description: Central NIH page summarizing status and implementation of multiple updates to NIH grant application, review, and reporting policies (e.g., simplified review framework, FORMS‑I, fellowship and training application changes, reference letter instructions). It informs applicants, reviewers, and institutions which changes apply and when.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simplified Review Framework for Most Research Project Grants (RPGs)
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH implemented a simplified framework for the peer review of the majority of competing research project grant (RPG) applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose/intent: part of efforts meant to simplify, clarify, and/or promote greater fairness towards a level playing field for applicants throughout the application and review processes. Alert (May 2025): NIH has expired some Notices of Funding Opportunity (NOFOs) with activity codes impacted by the simplified review framework which were not reissued with the updated review criteria or expired prior to January 25, 2025. No applications for due dates on or after May 25, 2025, will be accepted for those NOFOs, and applications already submitted will be reviewed under the simplified review framework. See NOT-OD-25-113 and NOT-OD-25-116 for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revisions to the NIH Fellowship Application and Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH revised the fellowship review criteria used to evaluate fellowship applications and modified the PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form to align with the restructured review criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alert (June 2025): New fellowship parent announcements for FORMS-I instructions (PDF) are now available. These revisions change how fellowship applications are evaluated and adjust application/supplemental form content to align with the restructured review criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updates to Institutional Training Grant Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH Training Program application instructions and data table forms were updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alert (March 2025): Recruitment Plans to Enhance Diversity are no longer required and those included in applications under review will not be evaluated or considered in funding decisions. FORMS-I Training data tables 6a, 6b, and 7 have been revised to remove calculations for % underrepresented minorities. A Trainee Diversity Report for institutional training grants, career development awards, and most research education grants is no longer required in Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPRs) and should not be included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updates to Reference Letter Instructions for Referees
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH updated the instructions for reference letters to provide more structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: so letters will better assist reviewers in understanding the candidate’s strengths, weaknesses, and potential to pursue a productive career in biomedical science. Referees should follow the updated, more-structured instructions when preparing reference letters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updated Application Forms and Instructions (FORMS‑I)
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH updated application forms to support current NIH requirements. Updated (FORMS‑I) application forms are posted with active funding opportunities, and updated instructions are available on the How to Apply - Application Guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alert (March 2025): The FORMS‑I instructions on How to Apply – Application Guide have been updated. See Significant Changes. Transition to FORMS‑I affects submission formatting, required fields, and data tables referenced elsewhere on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption of Common Forms for Biographical Sketch and Current and Pending (Other) Support
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH plans to adopt the Biographical Sketch Common Form and the Current and Pending (Other) Support Common Form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These common forms are part of efforts to standardize and simplify how applicant credentials and other support are reported across applications, consistent with broader FORMS‑I transitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation timing and applicability of changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain changes are implemented for due dates on or after January 25, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These changes include updates to the peer review and submission of most research project grants, fellowships, and training grants; updated instructions for reference letters; and the transition to FORMS‑I application instructions. Users should check specific Notices (e.g., NOT-OD-24-084) and alerts for exceptions, NOFO expirations, and later alerts (e.g., NOT-OD-25-113, NOT-OD-25-116) that affect acceptance windows and applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overarching implementation objective: simplify, clarify, and promote fairness
rubrics_metrics.description: The listed initiatives share a common goal: to simplify, clarify, and/or promote greater fairness towards a level playing field for applicants throughout the application and review processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This guiding principle should inform how applicants, institutions, and reviewers interpret and implement the specific changes (e.g., streamlined forms, revised review criteria, removal of certain diversity reporting requirements).
